findings.detail: complete_ledgers 8200054-8284498 at probe time (2026-11-23 00:45:48 UTC). 8,200,053 ledgers before 8200054 are absent from this node. Earliest close 2026-11-20 01:46:50 UTC, validated close 2026-11-23 00:45:50 UTC.
findings.title: History window is ~2.96 days: only 84,445 of 8,284,498 ledgers are held

findings.detail: Ledger 86785 returns lgrNotFound (error_code 21); the activation transaction 0E373029EEF6AB43E24D5F1EAFBAEB80BBA9B94610BCE1A3D004101CCFAE7048 returns txnNotFound (error_code 29). The VHS vote record is the only source: all 64 amendments share ledger 86785 and timestamp 2026-02-09T14:31:12.000Z. Corroboration: the 64 enabled amendments in feature_list are exactly the 64 VHS-activated names.
findings.title: The 86785 bulk activation (64 amendments, 2026-02-09) is not re-derivable from the node

findings.detail: The 6 validated-chain ledgers (8284493-8284498), the 3 earliest ledgers (8200054-8200056) and the flag ledger (8284160) all have empty transaction lists. No live recent-transaction lookup could be demonstrated in the probe window; the tx-lookup path was exercised only through the expected txnNotFound error.
findings.title: All 9 sampled ledgers carried zero transactions

findings.detail: Ledger 8201001 (never probed before, inside the complete range) returned on attempt 1 in drill B-01 (1,313.90 ms). Earlier packs saw first-call lgrNotFound for cold ledgers that resolved on retry, so clients must retry rather than treat the first error as final.
findings.title: Cold old-ledger lookup resolves, but not necessarily on the first call

findings.detail: Requested ledger_index_min 1; the node echoed ledger_index_min 8200054 and ledger_index_max 8284498. A caller asking for full history receives a silently truncated range.
findings.title: account_tx silently clamps ledger_index_min below the earliest held ledger

findings.detail: grep for 'snapshot' (case-insensitive) over the RPC handlers finds exactly one match: Subscribe.cpp:339, the `snapshot`/`state_now` flag of the subscribe call, which returns a live-state snapshot on subscription — not a ledger snapshot. grep over the ledger acquisition files finds zero matches. State sync happens only by SHAMap fetch from peers (InboundLedger fetchRoot + getNeededHashes).
findings.title: No native ledger-snapshot export/import exists in the pinned code

findings.detail: The validator list at postfiat.org/testnet_vl.json decodes (base64 JSON: sequence 30, 25 validators, publisher key ED3F1E0DA736FCF99BE2880A60DBD470715C0E04DD793FB862236B070571FC09E2, manifest 288 chars). Its blob signature is a 140-hex-char DER value; verifying it needs Ed25519, which Python's standard library does not provide, so signature verification is UNTESTABLE in this pack.
findings.title: VL blob signature is present but not verifiable with stdlib-only tooling

findings.detail: `validators`, `peers` and `ledger_request` all return HTTP 403 Forbidden. Sync-state visibility from the public RPC is limited to server_info, server_state and feature_list. An unknown method returns unknownCmd (error_code 32), not 403.
findings.title: Admin RPC methods return HTTP 403 from the public endpoint

findings.detail: https://explorer.testnet.postfiat.org/api/v1/health returned HTTP 500 with {"message": "rippled unreachable"} at probe time. The public explorer cannot corroborate ledger data.
findings.title: Explorer health is HTTP 500 (rippled unreachable)

findings.detail: Decoded blob: effective 848261408, expiration 891447293 (seconds since the Ripple epoch, 2000-01-01). The list is current (sequence 30) but expiry is a future rollover with no monitoring in this pack.
findings.title: VL blob carries an effective/expiration window that is not monitored by this pack

findings.detail: 17/17 sampled header hashes recompute (sha512Half of prefix 0x4C575200 plus the 9 header fields), 7/7 parent links hold, 5/5 rolling skip-list hashes match, 3/3 anchor skip positions match. The verifier is src/snapshot_verifier.py.
findings.title: Ledger-hash recomputation is fully reproducible in stdlib-only Python

findings.detail: 20 ledgers closed in a 60.8 s window (8284512-8284532). At 3.042 s/ledger the 8,200,053 pre-floor ledgers span ~288.7 days, and the validated ledger minus that span lands ~2026-02-07, two days before the VHS activation date 2026-02-09 — consistent within cadence drift. Full history (8,284,498 ledgers) at this cadence would take ~291.7 days to replay.
findings.title: Measured cadence 3.042 s/ledger is consistent with the history floor
